speech.heard: Sierra Leone has a gross enrollment ratio of 162%, the USA has 97%. In Sierra Leone, this ratio counts total enrollment, regardless of age, against the official school-age population. Sierra Leone is the world's highest with a gross enrollment ratio of 162%. Somalia is the world's lowest at 21%. India has a gross enrollment ratio of 111%, the USA has 97%. Rwanda has a gross enrollment ratio of 150%, Malawi has 139%, and Madagascar has 133%. China has 99.6%. What is the primary school enrollment rate in your country?
